title: L’occupation préhistorique de l’abri de Telarmachay (Pérou) : un aspect de la néolithisation andine
version: Comptes rendus des séances de l’Académie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres 132(2), pp. 266–285, DOI 10.3406/crai.1988.14604. Persée scan.
lineage: Primary excavation synthesis reporting the original camelid mortality and dental interpretation from the Telarmachay project, including the analyses by Jane Wheeler.

passages.locator: pp. 275–281, De la chasse à la domestication
passages.note: Older levels document a shift toward more specialized exploitation of camelids. A rise in fetal and neonatal remains and alpaca-like incisors in the subsequent sequence were interpreted as signs of domestication and confinement.
